combos.name: Sprinting Umbrella
combos.flavor: Opens itself when you break into a jog. Monsters find this unsettling.

combos.name: Dustpan Buckler
combos.flavor: A shield that also collects crumbs. Ondra calls it efficient.

combos.name: Protein Shaker Flail
combos.flavor: Rattles ominously. Smells faintly of banana.

combos.name: Tandem Kettlebell
combos.flavor: Requires two people to lift and one to laugh about it.

combos.name: Park Bench Banner
combos.flavor: A flag planted wherever two people sat and talked. Tobi designed it.

combos.name: Sunlit Flashcards
combos.flavor: Facts absorbed in daylight stick better. Imre has a chart.

combos.name: Morning-Light Lantern
combos.flavor: Charged by dawn, lit by a sensible bedtime. Lunel's favourite.

combos.name: Guest-Ready Doormat
combos.flavor: Says WELCOME in a tone that monsters respect.

combos.name: Well-Rested Thesis
combos.flavor: Argues, convincingly, that you should not be fought before coffee.

combos.name: Annotated Recipe Scroll
combos.flavor: Margins full of notes like 'more garlic' and 'why did this work'.

combos.name: Fluffy Towel Cape
combos.flavor: Warm, dry and faintly heroic. Marisol insists on the hood.

combos.name: Minty-Fresh Spatula
combos.flavor: Flips pancakes and freshens breath. Not at the same time, please.

combos.name: Boiled-Kettle Cannon
combos.flavor: A clean kitchen and a hot drink, weaponised.

combos.name: Whispered Lullaby Horn
combos.flavor: A goodnight message sent on time. Monsters doze off mid-charge.

combos.name: The Full Set
combos.flavor: All eight vassals in one day. Ondra has framed the clipboard page.
